Plans & itineraries

A day at Carocok & Langkisau

Pantai Carocok and Bukit Langkisau are in the Painan area and easy to combine. This page arranges a route without fixed figures.

Updated · 28 Oktober 2026

Order

Beach then hill

Enjoy the beach in the morning, then go up to Bukit Langkisau toward dusk for the panorama.

  • Morning: beach and photos.
  • Midday: eat in Painan.
  • Dusk: hill for panorama.

Activity

Paragliding

Paragliding depends on weather and operators; do not assume available every day.

Confirm

Ask about the paragliding schedule before coming specifically for that activity.

Backup

If rain

Use land activities at the beach if the hill is cloudy or raining heavily.

Questions

Before you go

01Is one day enough for beach and hill?+

Yes, both are in the Painan area so one day is enough.

02When to go to the hill?+

Toward dusk gives the best panorama; morning is also comfortable.

03May I paraglide?+

Depends on weather and operators; confirm the schedule.

04If it rains?+

Use land activities at the beach; do not force the hill trip.
